radiology_report:
Catharina Ziekenhuis, Eindhoven
Radiology Division | 01 Feb 2025 | Modality: Multiparametric MRI Prostate

Clinical Context: Assessment of elevated prostate-specific antigen at 4.8 ng/mL alongside a previously positive biopsy specimen. A PI-RADS 5 designation was assigned on the preceding scan.

Observations: Total glandular volume registers at 25.31 mL. Magnetic resonance sequences highlight a distinct hypointense focus within the right peripheral zone, spanning roughly 12 mm. Diffusion-weighted imaging and apparent diffusion coefficient maps exhibit pronounced restriction. Contrast dynamics show prompt, localized enhancement aligning with the T2 and diffusion anomalies. Capsular integrity remains intact with no seminal vesicle infiltration or nodal enlargement.

Conclusion: PI-RADS 5 lesion located in the right peripheral zone. PSAD 0.19 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.8035576.
